claims: Moldova is a landlocked Eastern European nation between Romania and Ukraine.
Moldova is a former Soviet republic.
The capital of Moldova is Chișinău.
The population of Moldova is approx 2.4-2.5 million.
Moldova is a pro-Western parliamentary republic.
Moldova is seeking EU accession.
Transnistria is a breakaway region of Moldova.
Cricova Winery and Mileștii Mici are wine cellars.
Mileștii Mici is the largest underground wine cellar in the world.
Orheiul Vechi is a historical-archaeological complex featuring cave monasteries.
Orheiul Vechi is located about 60km from Chișinău.
Soroca Fortress is a medieval fort.
Soroca Fortress was built by Stefan cel Mare.
Soroca Fortress is on the Dniester River.
Transnistria is a self-proclaimed breakaway region.
Transnistria is recognized by no one.
Moldova is governed by pro-European forces.
Maia Sandu is the President of Moldova.
President Maia Sandu advocates for EU integration.
President Maia Sandu aims for EU membership by 2030.
Moldova had a 2023–2024 push to sanction pro-Russian political figures.
Transnistria is a breakaway region in the east.
Transnistria hosts Russian troops.
Many citizens of Moldova hold dual citizenship.
Moldova was formerly part of the Russian Empire as Bessarabia.
Moldova was formerly part of Romania.
Moldova was incorporated into the Soviet Union after World War II.
Moldova gained independence in 1991.
The 1994 Constitution defines the language of Moldova as Moldovan.
The Constitutional Court ruled in 2013 that the official language of Moldova is Romanian
